capabilities: Chat with cloud and local AI providers inside Obsidian
Connect external MCP clients and CLI agents to the vault
Read, write, search and organize notes through agents
Run semantic and adaptive search over notes and conversations
Generate images, audio and video into the vault
disambiguation: Not a note-linking or graph plugin; it connects AI agents and chat to the vault.
extras: Mobile support is experimental; MCP, local providers, semantic search and ingestion are desktop-only. No telemetry; network requests are documented. Successor to Claudesidian.
intentEvidence: Nexus is the successor to Claudesidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for AI agents or external MCP clients to read, write, search and manage vault notes.
